ns2:section.sectionText: This course will focus on the development of graphic skills to represent the landscape, using both hand-drawn (pencil and color rendering) and introductory digital methods (e.g., AutoCAD and Photoshop). Students will also learn basic principles for organizing space and designing for function, using plant materials that are appropriate for site conditions. A variety of drafting tools and access to specific design software programs are required. To be taken concurrently with 55665. This is a 4 credit hour course.
